explanation: Proved: ternaryBasis is a basis of order 2 (every m ≥ 1 is a sum of at most 2 elements). Correct, and it is the first half of the Hennecart-style counterexample. These are private API lemmas supporting the formal disproof of Kelly's conjecture, which erdosproblems.com/338 reports was disproved by Hennecart: there is a basis of order 2 with no restricted order 3. Faithful.
